name: UrosOrchestrator

methods.name: set_storage
methods.desc: Pin which __storage app this orch manages.

methods.name: setup_default_box
methods.desc:
Allocate `__codebox_default` for __storage's default
bytecode. Caller funds box MBR before invoking.

methods.name: setup_chunk_box
methods.desc:
Allocate `__codebox_chunk_<i>` for chunk_idx, record its
length. Bumps chunk_count when a new index is added.

methods.name: register_chunk_method
methods.desc: Map an ABI selector to its owning chunk.

methods.name: register_chunk_method_chain
methods.desc:
Register a piece-chain for `selector`. `entries` is a packed
byte string of N×12-byte records: 8 bytes big-endian `chunk_idx`, then 4 bytes `piece_selector`. dispatch() detects this entry first and routes via dispatch_chain semantics so live vars cross piece boundaries via gload.

methods.name: dispatch_chain
methods.desc:
Chain-dispatch a registered piece chain. ApplicationArgs
layout matches dispatch():     [0] = "dispatch_chain()" selector     [1] = user's primary selector (the original method)     [2..] = user's args (forwarded to every piece)
For chain_len N, stages 2N+1 inner-txns in one group:     install_0 (begin), call_0, install_1, call_1, ...,     install_{N-1}, call_{N-1}, restore (default). Returns op.GITxn.last_log(2N-1) — last piece's call output.
v3 supports chain_len ∈ {2..7} (2N+1 ≤ 16 AVM inner-txn cap). Each piece's chunk and the default storage may be up to 4 pages (8 KB).
Implementation: install/call/restore are three helper subroutines. dispatch_chain decodes pieces, then orchestrates the per-chain-length sequence as a flat list of subroutine calls. Keeps the contract small (subroutine bodies emitted once, called many times).

methods.name: dispatch
methods.desc:
The dance: install chunk → run selector on __storage →
restore default. Returns the inner call's last_log.
ApplicationArgs layout (from main's forwarded inner txn):   [0] = "dispatch()" selector  (consumed by ABI router)   [1] = user's selector  (the original method)   [2..N+1] = user's args (forwarded as-is)

desc:
Per-call program-swap orchestrator. Holds N chunks of bytecode
    in boxes; dispatch() runs the 3-itxn dance per call against
    __storage.
